# Contact Sheet Report

## 1) Visual Medium
Real footage — live-action first-person POV video (phone camera, indoor room). No game engine. No game HUD/UI; only a white TikTok-style caption overlay at the top of every frame.

## 2) On-Screen Text (frame by frame)
Every frame (1–12) shows the same caption at the top, verbatim:
- **Frame 1:** "While they are out partying btw"
- **Frame 2:** "While they are out partying btw"
- **Frame 3:** "While they are out partying btw"
- **Frame 4:** "While they are out partying btw"

- **Frame 10:** "While they are out partying btw"
- **Frame 11:** "While they are out partying btw"
- **Frame 12:** "While they are out partying btw"

No other legible text (no clock, signs, or readable watermark).

## 3) Visual Arc
- **Frames 1–3:** POV looking down at a dark wooden table; two McDonald's burgers on yellow wrapping paper, two plastic water bottles behind them; two pairs of hands hover over the burgers (two people reaching).
- **Frames 4–7:** The burgers get grabbed away one by one; hands clutching wrapped burgers; motion blur as one is snatched. Yellow paper wrappers remain.
- **Frame 8–9:** Camera tilts up revealing a person wearing a dark navy t-shirt with a yellow **McDonald's "M" logo** on the chest, gesturing with both hands (burgers now gone, wrappers on table).
- **Frames 10–11:** Person in the McDonald's shirt handles/tosses a wrapped burger; motion blur; camera moves to a different, lighter part of the room with clutter and what looks like a fish tank in the background.
- **Frame 12:** A single unwrapped cheeseburger sits alone on yellow wrapper on the table — the last one left.
- **Palette:** Warm wood browns/yellow wrappers throughout; brighter white-wall setting in later frames. Same daytime indoor lighting; time of day unchanged.

## 4) TikTok Username/Watermark
None visible — no username, watermark, or logo legible in any frame (caption text present but unattributed).

## 5) One-Line Story Guess
Roommates/employees left behind grab all the McDonald's burgers while everyone else is out partying — leaving just one burger at the end.
